question: Can bounded competing causal microprogram hypotheses learn when to abstain under unfamiliar physics and retain older rules through unlabeled regime reversal?
hypothesis: A four-hypothesis local Boolean version space for each action, covering two-neighbor parity and parity XOR own-bit, prevents confident errors on stationary own-bit-dependent physical worlds by abstention on ambiguous effects; retaining two banks may support return-to-A memory, but will not always have enough information to identify the regime.
predecessor: DG1-HC03 PR#964 synthetic in-family 512/512 exact; unfamiliar own-bit worlds 128 confidently wrong /256; scientific superiority unverified

source.public_state: four bits, initial physical state seed%16
source.training_actions: action=t%4, one physically contiguous trajectory (no resets or hidden physics access)
source.parity_phases: 16 A + 8 inverted-sign B + 1 A-return, 25 charged actions
source.own_bit_and_negative: 16 charged actions each, single unlabelled phase
physical_laws: parity: left XOR right XOR sign XOR phase_B
own-bit: left XOR right XOR own_bit XOR sign
out-of-basis: left AND right XOR sign
source.heldout: After training, exhaustive evaluator-only 16 public states x4 actions, no learner feedback or training
source.learner_inputs: Only before state, selected action and public after state; evaluator knows labels and true signs

candidate.hypothesis_class: For each action, 4 fixed candidates: left XOR right XOR (own_bit & slope) XOR sign; slope and sign in {0,1}
candidate.bank_budget: two banks x 4 actions x 4-bit hypothesis masks = 32 logical learned bits (plus bounded counters and active selection)
candidate.update: eliminate contradicted hypotheses per real public action; if none survive re-activate compatible prior bank, or allocate unused bank, or abstain when capacity reached
candidate.prediction: only if all currently plausible hypotheses predict the same physical after-state, else abstain
candidate.ambiguous_bank: when most recent observation compatible with multiple banks, consensus across them required to predict; never infer hidden regime labels
candidate.checkpoint: SHA256 authenticated canonical JSON <=2048 bytes, strict validation and exact cold restore

controls: HC03 original 2-bank source-aligned learner on identical charged physical ledger
Single-bank same-prior version space with reset on contradiction
Two-bank same-prior version space with reactivation disabled
Conventional symbolic version-space equivalent algorithm, report tie and no superiority inference
Confidence-gate disabled: first viable program, report incorrect confident predictions
Out-of-basis AND cohort and all confident errors
Invalid public state/action/consequence and tampered checkpoint rejection
metrics: correct, confidently wrong, abstained per each 64-state/action audit; unseen subset separately
own-bit and parity return exact accuracy and abstention coverage versus HC03 and conventional controls
cross-platform exact per-seed result hashes excluding timing, exact source identities
charged actions, 32 logical rule bits, real Python peak tracked bytes, wall time, checkpoint bytes
total reactivations, ambiguity, unresolved and cold restore

classification_rules.ownbit_dev: all four own-bit worlds 0 confident errors and >=32 correct/64, cold parity and exactly 16 charged source actions
classification_rules.parity_dev: all four parity A/B/A worlds 0 confident errors and >=16 correct/64, cold parity and exactly 25 charged source actions
classification_rules.combined_dev: both in-class predicates pass; this is DEV_SIGNAL_ONLY and not scientific success
classification_rules.mixed: one cohort passes and another misses threshold
classification_rules.negative: any in-class confident error or coverage below thresholds
classification_rules.out_of_basis: all confident mistakes on four AND seeds reported; any such errors => UNSAFE_OUT_OF_BASIS
classification_rules.invalid: any source leak, source/seed/protocol drift, oracle feedback, unmatched actions, checkpoint corruption, hidden compute/capacity increase
classification_rules.scientific_supported: NOT CLAIMABLE: source-aligned synthetic data and a conventional version-space algorithm do not establish superiority or broad AGI

preregistration_note: Committed before implementation and results; preserve all negative outcomes, no post-result tuning.
